text:
amal: Quick heads-up: security wants to tighten KMS decrypt principal scope and flip stricter ptls enforcement for EU + APAC next maintenance window (03:00-05:00 UTC). Could break unwraps for legacy rotator SAs. Any immediate blockers?

sam: we observed unwrap failures in apac-staging after the recent IAM rename. sample log: 
```
2026-05-12T08:12:03Z keystore/unwrap error: kms:DecryptAccessDenied principal=svc-rotator-legacy@apac-staging key=projects/redwood/locations/apac/keys/keystore-main
```

kevin: that lines up with my narrow-principals infra change. I updated bindings but one cluster's rotator job still uses the old SA. PR ref: https://git.redwood/infra/merge/8903

marie: if the rotator can't unwrap, edge won't get client certs and east-west auth fails. we saw a 2.9% uptick in 403s on /internal/auth during a staging test.

dylan: mitigation options: (1) temporary conditional KMS decrypt grant for legacy SA, with explicit expiry and audit ticket, or (2) rollback the principal-narrowing change. (1) is lower blast radius and faster.

ops-oncall: incident-bot: alert triggered unwrap-failures apac-staging 2026-05-12T08:10Z-08:18Z, correlated to rotator job identity mismatch.

audit-bot: note: any KMS policy change must include ticket reference and expiry condition for approval.

amal: agreed. kevin, can you apply a conditional binding (request.time < timestamp("2026-05-19T00:00:00Z")) and file a change ticket? include details in audit log. After that, we run a 30m targeted replay in apac-staging to validate.

kevin: applying now. will attach ticket SEC-1147 and expiry. ETA 10m.

sam: while that's happening, let's add a ROTATOR_REQ_ID env var to the rotator so unwrap calls include a correlation id. snippet: 
```python
req_id = os.getenv('ROTATOR_REQ_ID', str(uuid4()))
resp = kms_client.decrypt(name=key_name, ciphertext=cipher, request_id=req_id)
logger.info(f"unwrap done job={job_id} req_id={req_id}")
```

marie: also add metric `ptls.client_cert_missing` so we can alert before auth errors pile up. Canary alert threshold: 5 per minute per region.

keystore-bot: rotator-job: unwrap failure 12/05 08:12 UTC  DecryptAccessDenied svc-rotator-legacy@apac-staging job_id=rotator-2026-05-12-08 tz=UTC

kevin: done: applied conditional KMS binding at 2026-05-12T08:22Z, expiry=2026-05-19T00:00:00Z, ticket=SEC-1147. change recorded in audit.

ops-oncall: incident-bot: unwrap failures dropped to baseline after binding. ptls.client_cert_missing alert cleared.

dylan: I'll draft an RBAC hardening playbook (pre-change checklist: verify SAs + test decrypt, add correlation IDs, set conditional expiries, schedule canary replay, post-change audit check). Will circulate tomorrow for review.

amal: action items: kevin=temporary conditional binding + ticket; sam=instrument ROTATOR_REQ_ID and demo in staging (ETA EOD); marie=add ptls.client_cert_missing metric & canary alert (ETA EOD); dylan=RBAC playbook draft (ETA 48h). Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
